tools.name: loopsubscriptions_get_subscription
tools.description: Read one subscription: status, billing, delivery, products and next order. Loop API: GET /subscription/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions for the store, with optional filters and cursor paging. This list has a small per-store pool (3 requests per 3 s); use filters. Loop API: GET /subscription.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_customer_subscriptions
tools.description: List the subscriptions of one customer, by Shopify customer id, with an optional status filter. Loop API: GET /customer/{customerIdentifier}/subscription.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_find_subscriptions_by_email
tools.description: List the subscriptions of the customer with this email address. Use it when the Shopify customer id is unknown. Loop API: GET /customer/{customerEmailAddress}/subscription.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_order_schedule
tools.description: List the scheduled future orders of one subscription. Loop API: GET /subscription/{subscriptionId}/order/schedule.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_order_history
tools.description: List the orders already placed for one subscription. Loop API: GET /subscription/{subscriptionId}/order/history.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_activity_logs
tools.description: List the activity log (changes and events) of one subscription, with cursor paging. Loop API: GET /subscription/{subscriptionId}/activityLog.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer by Shopify customer id: their subscriptions and loyalty account. Loop API: GET /customer/{customerShopifyId}.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their subscription count, with an optional email filter and cursor paging. This list has a small per-store pool (1 request per s). Loop API: GET /customer.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_scheduled_orders
tools.description: List the subscription orders due for billing in a date range (operations view: what ships next). This list has a small per-store pool (2 requests per 3 s). Loop API: GET /orders/schedule.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_past_orders
tools.description: List subscription orders for the store, filtered by Shopify creation, billing or update time, with cursor paging. This list has a small per-store pool (2 requests per 3 s). Loop API: GET /orders.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_products
tools.description: List the store products and whether each one has a subscription selling plan. This list has a small per-store pool (6 requests per s). Loop API: GET /product.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.description: List the subscription selling plan groups of the store (the billing and delivery plans offered). Loop API: GET /sellingPlanGroup.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_pause_subscription
tools.description: Pause a subscription: no billing and no deliveries until it resumes. Pass pause_duration to pause for a fixed time; omit it to pause until resumed. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/pause.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_resume_subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription on its original schedule. This restarts billing and deliveries. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/resume.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_skip_next_order
tools.description: Skip the next scheduled order of a subscription; later orders stay scheduled. This changes what the customer is charged and shipped. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/skipNext.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription
tools.description: Reactivate a cancelled subscription on its original schedule. This restarts billing. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/reactivate.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_update_note
tools.description: Replace the internal note on a subscription. The customer does not see it. Loop API: PUT /subscription/{subscriptionId}/note.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: loopsubscriptions_find_subscriptions_by_email, loopsubscriptions_list_customers · Public sink: loopsubscriptions_find_subscriptions_by_email, loopsubscriptions_list_customers, loopsubscriptions_pause_subscription, loopsubscriptions_resume_subscription, loopsubscriptions_skip_next_order, loopsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: loopsubscriptions_find_subscriptions_by_email, loopsubscriptions_list_customers · Public sink: loopsubscriptions_find_subscriptions_by_email, loopsubscriptions_list_customers, loopsubscriptions_pause_subscription, loopsubscriptions_resume_subscription, loopsubscriptions_skip_next_order, loopsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
